Source.Name: sdl3-net
Source.Summary: Small sample cross-platform networking library for SDL3.
Source.Description: SDL_net is a portable network library for use with SDL3. Its goal is to simplify the use of the usual socket interfaces and use SDL infrastructure to handle some portability things (such as threading and reporting errors).
